purpose: Repair the remaining SIMBA extreme-quantile error without repeating V41's destruction of stochastic small-scale power: keep the V41 block-risk and object-amplitude predictors fixed, learn native extreme locations only inside seeded blocks, and calibrate only a strictly monotone upper residual-tail excess while leaving the conditional residual body at unit scale.

inherited_inputs.selection_rule: reuse every frozen V28/V31 query, donor identity, donor isometry, and member pairing byte-for-byte

train_only_native_extreme_model.label: native train voxel log10 density exceeds its source-specific q99.99 threshold already frozen in the V41 fit artifact
train_only_native_extreme_model.features: the exact V36 221-component native scalar plus ordered 3x3x3 native and factor-4 parent observable/backbone descriptor, excluding every target component
train_only_native_extreme_model.rows: for each source retain every positive native train voxel up to 32768 by frozen PCG64 priority and the same number of negatives; use the common minimum retained positive count and exact source/class balance
train_only_native_extreme_model.native_seed_voxels_per_seed_block: round to nearest integer the equal-source mean number of q99.99-positive native train voxels per cube divided by the unchanged V41 seed_block_count

nested_rank_transport.coarse: reuse the exact V41 full-risk factor-4 block permutation with 11 carrier blocks and no global residual scaling
nested_rank_transport.native_query_risk: evaluate the frozen native classifier only for the 64 voxels in each of the 11 seeded query blocks
nested_rank_transport.native_carriers: the fixed count of highest conditional-rank voxels inside each already transported 4^3 donor block
nested_rank_transport.native_targets: the same count of highest native-risk query voxels in that block
nested_rank_transport.native_assignment: descending native carrier rank to descending native query risk with deterministic native-flat-index ties
nested_rank_transport.completion: complete each 64-voxel map by identity wherever possible and deterministic minimum periodic within-block displacement for the remaining cycle
invariants: exact 64-voxel permutation inside every modified block
exact preservation of the complete donor conditional-rank multiset before inverse
no changes outside the 11 seeded blocks

body_preserving_tail_calibration.uncalibrated_residual: V31 conditional inverse of the nested transported rank field at the actual query backbone followed by exact residual-mean subtraction
body_preserving_tail_calibration.tail_threshold: the train-only V31 conditional residual q99.9 value evaluated at each query backbone voxel
body_preserving_tail_calibration.decomposition: r_body=min(r,threshold) and positive excess=max(r-threshold,0) are used algebraically; the output is r_body+lambda*excess with lambda strictly positive, so no flat cap is emitted
body_preserving_tail_calibration.fixed_solver: evaluate predicted object log10 mean delta squared at the three fixed lambda knots, linearly interpolate lambda in the first bracketing log-amplitude segment, or choose the nearest fixed boundary when unbracketed, then evaluate once
body_preserving_tail_calibration.body_invariant: after removing the single exact DC projection, every voxel at or below its train-only tail threshold is byte-identical to the unit-scale uncalibrated residual
body_preserving_tail_calibration.object_amplitude_prediction: byte-identical V41 full object-regressor prediction; no refit or alternate target

matched_arms.within_block_tail_body: full V41 block risk, actual native within-block risk, and body-preserving tail-only calibration
matched_arms.block_only_tail_control: full V41 block risk, no native within-block rearrangement, and the same tail-only calibration
matched_arms.rolled_native_risk_control: full V41 block risk, native risk periodically rolled by (1,2,3) inside every 4^3 block, and the same tail-only calibration
matched_arms.tail_calibration_disabled_control: identical nested rank transport with lambda fixed to one; diagnostic only and ineligible for selection
matched_arms.common: identical query, V31 donor/isometry, coarse block carrier, object-amplitude prediction, conditional inverse, and exact DC projection

development_evaluation.primary_pass: within_block_tail_body passes field, Q3, and Q4 independently in every domain

fixed_branches.condition: Q3 and Q4 pass every domain and high-k power plus residual RMS pass every domain but another field check fails
Q3 and Q4 pass every domain but high-k power or residual RMS fails anywhere
Q4 passes every domain but Q3 fails anywhere

hard_preflight: full pytest and clean committed worktree
exact V41 parent, V41 fit, V35 data/cache, V31 copula, selection, and reference hashes
native model fit is source/class balanced and opens train targets only
synthetic and real nested permutations preserve every conditional-rank value exactly
real candidate is finite, uses global body scale one, lambda in [1/64,1], and residual DC below 1e-7
non-tail residual difference after undoing DC is below 1e-7
Astrid and historical EAGLE remain unopened
